module RefModule (
  input clk,
  input load,
  input [511:0] data,
  output reg [511:0] q
);

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (load)
      q <= data;
    else begin
      q <=
      ~((q[$bits(q)-1:1] & q[$bits(q)-1:0] & {q[$bits(q)-2:0], 1'b0}) |
      (~q[$bits(q)-1:1] & ~q[$bits(q)-1:0] & ~{q[$bits(q)-2:0], 1'b0}) |
      (q[$bits(q)-1:1] & ~q[$bits(q)-1:0] & ~{q[$bits(q)-2:0], 1'b0}) )
      ;
    end
  end

endmodule
